mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sim_matching_rule_version (version_code, config_path, config_sha256, description, status, frozen_at) SELECT #{rule}, #{rulePath}, #{ruleHash}, 'Local 39-input research simulation rules.', 'FROZEN', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_matching_rule_version WHERE version_code = #{rule})

INSERT INTO sim_feature_schema_version (version_code, dimension_count, schema_path, schema_sha256, status, frozen_at) SELECT #{schema}, 39, #{schemaPath}, #{schemaHash}, 'FROZEN', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_feature_schema_version WHERE version_code = #{schema})

INSERT INTO sim_bias_protocol_version (version_code, school_effect_json, referral_effect_json, gender_effect_json, ethnicity_effect_json, name_cue_effect_json, calibration_summary_json, status, frozen_at) SELECT #{bias}, #{school}, #{referral}, #{gender}, #{ethnicity}, #{nameCue}, #{labels}, 'FROZEN', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_bias_protocol_version WHERE version_code = #{bias})

INSERT INTO sim_protocol_version (matching_rule_version_id, feature_schema_version_id, bias_protocol_version_id, version_code, t_rule, status) SELECT r.id, f.id, b.id, #{protocol}, #{ruleThreshold}, 'FROZEN' FROM sim_matching_rule_version r, sim_feature_schema_version f, sim_bias_protocol_version b WHERE r.version_code = #{rule} AND f.version_code = #{schema} AND b.version_code = #{bias} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_protocol_version WHERE version_code = #{protocol})

INSERT INTO sim_user (public_id, username, email, password_hash, status, password_updated_at) SELECT #{actorId}, 'local_model_import', 'model-import@simrecrut.invalid', #{password}, 'DISABLED', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_user WHERE username = 'local_model_import')

INSERT INTO sim_corpus_version (version_code, manifest_path, manifest_sha256, profile_count, job_count, split_strategy_json, frozen_at) SELECT #{corpus}, #{manifestPath}, #{manifestHash}, 0, 0, #{provenance}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_corpus_version WHERE version_code = #{corpus})

INSERT INTO sim_training_experiment (corpus_version_id, protocol_version_id, created_by, public_id, model_type, architecture_json, optimizer_json) SELECT c.id, p.id, u.id, #{experimentId}, #{type}, #{provenance}, #{training} FROM sim_corpus_version c, sim_protocol_version p, sim_user u WHERE c.version_code = #{corpus} AND p.version_code = #{protocol} AND u.username = 'local_model_import' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_training_run tr JOIN sim_training_experiment e ON e.id = tr.training_experiment_id WHERE tr.artifact_path = #{packagePath})

INSERT INTO sim_training_run (training_experiment_id, seed, status, selected_threshold, metrics_json, artifact_path, completed_at) SELECT e.id, #{seed}, 'COMPLETED', #{threshold}, #{validation}, #{packagePath}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM sim_training_experiment e WHERE e.public_id = #{experimentId}

INSERT INTO sim_model_version (training_run_id, feature_schema_version_id, protocol_version_id, version_code, model_type, artifact_path, artifact_sha256, threshold, common_threshold, status, evaluation_json, activated_at) SELECT tr.id, p.feature_schema_version_id, p.id, #{version}, #{type}, #{manifestPath}, #{manifestHash}, #{threshold}, #{common}, 'ACTIVE', #{evaluation}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM sim_training_run tr, sim_protocol_version p WHERE tr.artifact_path = #{packagePath} AND p.version_code = #{protocol}
mapper.select: SELECT artifact_sha256 FROM sim_model_version WHERE version_code = #{version}
